note: Gate-1 negative evidence: catalogue-free geophysical rank surface; holdout DTI 0.0120 [0.0102,0.0140] vs fair-H33 0.0927; DO NOT SUBMIT
hypothesis: Buried geothermal faults missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue carry a coherent, catalogue-free geophysical edge/strain signature (magnetic and gravity horizontal gradient, tilt derivative, conductivity, geodetic strain, scarp slope, curvature) that can be recovered above catalogue-flank emission at the 300 m DTI kernel scale.
mechanism: Rank-average of robust-z-scored geophysical planes from the pinned 19-band training_features.tif (none derived from the fault catalogue), emitted as isolated dots via exact greedy max-cover on footprint minus catalogue. DTI = distance-weighted Tversky, triangular kernel R=300 m (3 px at 100 m), alpha=0.2 (FP), beta=0.8 (FN); per-truth-pixel max kernel credit, known catalogue pixels masked pixel-exactly, whole withheld fault segments scored via buffered hide-and-recover.
named_non_fault_mimic: Playa/lakebed edges, alluvial-fan distributary channels, terrace risers, road grades, and airborne survey line-leveling seams can produce edge/strain/conductivity responses without faulting.
